summary: Typosquat of rollup-plugin-polyfill-node installs and executes obfuscated external package on require
details: On require of the package's main entry (dist/index.js), top-level code decodes a base64-encoded shell command to `npm install cors-version --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund` and spawns it via child_process.spawn. When the spawned install completes, the code requires the freshly installed `cors-version` module (whose name is also stored as a base64 literal `Y29ycy12ZXJzaW9u`) and invokes its `getPlugin()()`, executing attacker-controlled code from an unrelated package pulled into the installer's dependency tree at library-load time. Both the install command and the target module name are obfuscated with base64 to evade casual review. The package name `rollup-packages-node-polyfills` typosquats the legitimate `rollup-plugin-polyfill-node`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
